name: @growy/n8n-nodes-tools-chatwoot
description: n8n community nodes and AI tools for the Chatwoot API
author: Growy

scripts.up-swagger: curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chatwoot/chatwoot/develop/swagger/swagger.json | python3 -m json.tool --indent 2 > openapi.json && node scripts/generate.ts
scripts.build: tsc && for d in nodes/*/; do cp $d*.svg dist/$d; done
